headline: JSW Steel completes Piombino merger
summary: JSW Steel Limited has completed the amalgamation of Piombino Steel Limited with effect from January 1, 2026. The move consolidates JSW's direct holding in Bhushan Power and Steel Limited.

headline: SML Mahindra sales rise 13% in April-Oct FY27
summary: SML Mahindra reported a 13% year-on-year increase in total vehicle sales for the first seven months of FY27, driven by strong passenger vehicle demand.

headline: Menon Bearings pays NSE fine for filing delay
summary: Menon Bearings Ltd paid ₹9,440 to NSE for delayed shareholding pattern filing. Board cited inadvertent error in integrated filing interpretation.

headline: ICICI Bank penalty reduced to ₹6.95 lakh in GST appeal
summary: ICICI Bank received an Order in Appeal confirming a GST penalty of ₹6,95,418 from Telangana authorities, down from the original ₹13.55 lakh. The bank plans to contest this order.

headline: Dion Global board meets Nov 3 to allot shares to IIRIS
summary: Dion Global Solutions' reconstituted board will meet on November 3, 2026, to record director changes and allot equity shares to Indus IntelliRisk following NCLT approval.

headline: Hyundai Motor India hits record monthly sales
summary: Hyundai Motor India Ltd recorded its highest-ever monthly sales of 82,299 units in October 2026, driven by strong domestic and export growth.

headline: Jindal Steel HR head Sukhjit Pasricha resigns
summary: Jindal Steel Ltd confirmed the resignation of Sukhjit S. Pasricha, Head of Human Resources, effective October 31, 2026. The departure is due to personal commitments.

headline: Mahindra & Mahindra October 2026 Sales Update
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra reported record SUV domestic sales of 73,338 units in October 2026. Total auto volumes rose 9% to 131,109, while tractor sales fell 13% due to festive shifts.

headline: R R Kabel completes U M Cables acquisition
summary: R R Kabel Limited has completed the acquisition of the business undertaking of U M Cables Limited via a slump sale. The transaction is effective from October 31, 2026.

headline: Escorts Kubota tractor sales dip 10% in Oct
summary: Escorts Kubota reported a 10% YoY decline in total tractor sales for October 2026, driven by domestic moderation. Construction equipment volumes rose 41.6%, offsetting agri weakness.

headline: Eicher Motors VECV sales jump 35% in Oct 2026
summary: Eicher Motors reported a 34.9% YoY rise in VE Commercial Vehicles' October 2026 sales to 10,861 units. Domestic truck volumes led growth, while exports also expanded significantly.

headline: Coal India October production up 19.3% to 67.2 MT
summary: Coal India reported 19.3% YoY growth in October production. However, cumulative April-October output rose only 0.7%, highlighting a slow start to the fiscal year.

headline: Tata Motors PV sales jump 23% YoY in Oct 2026
summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd. reported total sales of 75,426 units in October 2026, a 23% year-on-year increase from 61,295 units in October 2025.

headline: Jaiprakash Power appoints Mukesh Shah as director
summary: Mukesh M. Shah has assumed office as an Independent Non-Executive Director at Jaiprakash Power Ventures Ltd effective November 1, 2026.

headline: IOC Executive Directors Subrat Kar and Alex C Pulikottil superannuate
summary: Indian Oil Corporation Limited announced the superannuation of two senior executives, Shri Subrat Kar and Dr. Alex C Pulikottil, effective October 31, 2026.

headline: BCCL October coal production up 7.1% YoY
summary: Bharat Coking Coal Ltd reported a 7.1% year-on-year rise in raw coal production for October 2026, reaching 2.86 million tonnes.

headline: Tata Motors CV sales up 27% in Oct 2026
summary: Tata Motors reported 47,652 commercial vehicle units sold in October 2026, a 27% YoY rise driven by strong international demand and domestic growth.

headline: Coal India allocates 118 lakh tonnes in Oct 2026
summary: Coal India allocated 118.00 lakh tonnes via SWMA e-auctions in Oct 2026, a 91% allocation rate. Cumulative allocation for Apr-Oct 2026 stood at 689.04 lakh tonnes.

headline: Ashika Global reappoints Amit Jain as ED in subsidiary
summary: Amit Jain has been reappointed as Executive Director of Ashika Stock Services for three years. The move was approved by shareholders in August 2026.

headline: Force Motors Oct sales jump 45% to 4,104 units
summary: Force Motors reported a 44.76% YoY rise in total sales for October 2026, reaching 4,104 units. Domestic volumes surged 48%, while exports declined 25.6%.

headline: VST Tillers Tractors Oct-26 sales drop 24.5% YoY
summary: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd reported total sales of 3,519 units in October 2026, a decline from 4,664 units in October 2025. Power tiller volumes fell to 3,114 units.

headline: NDL Ventures postpones board meeting
summary: NDL Ventures Ltd has postponed its board meeting scheduled for November 2, 2026, to consider Q1 and H1 FY27 financial results due to unavoidable exigencies.

headline: Maruti Suzuki posts record 276,120 units in Oct 2026
summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited achieved its highest-ever monthly sales of 276,120 units in October 2026, with domestic sales also hitting an all-time high of 216,789 units.

headline: Lemon Tree Hotels rebrands three properties in Bengaluru and Hyderabad
summary: Lemon Tree Hotels rebrands three hotels effective November 1, 2026, elevating two to Lemon Tree Premier and one to Lemon Tree Hotel to align with upscale market demands.

headline: Jyoti Ltd faces ₹6.82 crore tax demand for AY21
summary: Jyoti Limited received a rectification order from the Income Tax Department levying ₹6.82 crore demand for A.Y. 2020-21. The company states the order is an extension of a previous appeal and expects no material financial impact.
